messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD#INC-8421 - HOST gpu-node-72 lost heartbeat (kubelet NotReady) — auto-page to oncall
incident-bot: Alert fired 6378001234, severity P1, escalation path: primary -> secondary
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident INC-8421 acknowledged by rahul
rahul: acked on-call, jumping in
rahul: node IP 10.240.72.9, kubelet status NotReady, last-seen ~2m ago
emily: saw a burst of pages for this node, looks like flapping vs repeated alerts
dario: checking hypervisor/power logs now — I see a host reset at ~6378001228, possible powercycle
rahul: ssh timed out (connection refused) so opening serial console
incident-bot: Serial console attached: snippet shows "Kernel panic - not syncing: Out of memory: kill process 1782 (kubelet) score 900" at ~6378001225
emily: kernel OOM then host reset — could be runaway process or hardware thermal/psu issue
dario: pulling control-plane traces and kubelet events, running: ```kubectl get node gpu-node-72 -o wide
kubectl describe node gpu-node-72
journalctl -k -b -1 | tail -n 50
```
rahul: cordoning node to avoid new scheduling: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-72`
rahul: starting drain with `kubectl drain gpu-node-72 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`
rahul: drain stuck on pod gpu-trainer-abc (Terminating) — eviction failing, maybe kernel-level hang
emily: high-risk customers on that rack: skylark-ai (3 pods), video-gen (1 active job) — notifying CS/Sales
dario: router routing-policy check: autoscale should pick up load; I'll create a temporary route to spare pool
rahul: infra: opened RMA ticket TICKET-3972, asked infra to validate powercycle source and hardware health
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to secondary — paging emily
emily: on it. initiating mitigations: spinning up spare nodes and rerouting jobs
emily: running `redwoodctl reroute --from gpu-node-72 --to pool-spare --grace 60s` to shift traffic
rahul: observed nvme SMART WARN for /dev/nvme1 before panic — temp spike reported, could be thermal issue
dario: note: kubelet briefly flipped Ready then back to NotReady — indicates unstable boot sequence
emily: notifying customer-success: @cs-team skylark notified with initial blurb on transient node failures; will follow up in 30m
rahul: plan: once infra confirms host stable, restart kubelet (`systemctl restart kubelet`) and run memtest and SMART; if failures persist, cordon+drain permanently and RMA
dario: escalated to hardware team: possible PSU/IMM firmware flakiness, rack-level checks in progress
rahul: leaving a runbook note: when kernel OOM + powercycle, check for runaway container memory, check host-level OOM and thermal logs, then RMA if hw shows errors
anaction: (typo) -- ignore
anaction: -- corrected -- (not a real msg)
ana: ack — will pick up at handoff time in ~3h and monitor PD for re-fires
incident-bot: Captured log excerpt: ```[6378001225] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 1782 (kubelet) score 900
[6378001226] kernel: CPU0: Temperature above threshold, throttling
[6378001228] hostd: power-cycle initiated by hypervisor
```
emily: setting follow-up ticket OPS-1844 for postmortem and runbook updates, assigning dario/rahul to triage
rahul: marking PD incident as acknowledged and in-progress; will update incident timeline in the ticket
emily: thanks everyone. keep this thread for updates. escalate immediately if we get more pages or customer impact increases :thumbsup:
